summary: Play, pilot and learn how airplanes, drones, hot air balloons & helicopters fly
description:
"How Do Things Fly?" is an educational and fun game for learning how flying machines work: the plane, the helicopter, the drone and the hot air balloon... Pilot the different aircraft and watch the different forces interact. What makes an airplane fly? How do you turn or descend? How can a hot air balloon stay in the air? What physical laws are behind all this?

Play and learn as you internalize scientific concepts and thus develop scientific thought, logic and curiosity. Why do helicopters have a propeller on their tail? And why do drones have 4 engines? Do they all rotate in the same direction?

With "How Do Things Fly?", you can freely play and learn, with no pressure or stress. Think, act, observe, ask questions and find answers. Have fun answering one of the most curious questions: how do planes fly?

FEATURES

• Helps develop scientific thinking.
• Easy and intuitive scenarios, with interfaces that appeal to children.
• Includes basic concepts for understanding physics and its laws.
• Discover some of the most spectacular flying machines.
• Learn how things work, like motors, wings, hot air balloons... 
• Content for children ages 5 and up. A game for the whole family. 
• No ads.
